verdict.rationale: mParticle documents GDPR/CCPA compliance and Data Privacy Controls with consent state and forwarding rules (e.g., suppressing forwarding on CCPA opt-out) which relates to data governance, but the evidence pack never explicitly documents a data retention policy or a deletion/erasure API/workflow. missing for 10: explicit data retention policy documentation, a documented deletion/erasure endpoint or workflow, independent confirmation the deletion mechanism works as claimed.
